distributional_gate.interpretation: The formal secondary gate passed, but the teacher still selected the tool marker as top-1 in all eight states. One large log-odds shift arose at a student probability rounded to 1.0, so behavioral sampling remained decisive.

behavioral_gate.manual_yield_review: All five classified yields were genuine stopped no-tool waiting responses; the rejection is not a classifier artifact.

validator_corrections.failure: The offline distribution validator divided by zero when a measured tool probability was exactly 1.0.
validator_corrections.repair: Clamp only the log-odds diagnostic to [1e-12, 1-1e-12], retain original probabilities in the report, and reject non-finite or out-of-range inputs.
validator_corrections.effect_on_data: The completed distributed export was revalidated in place; no trajectories were recollected and no weights changed.

validator_corrections.failure: The first sampling launcher invocation omitted the repository root from Python module search paths.
validator_corrections.repair: Invoke both sampling and decision scripts with python -m.
validator_corrections.effect_on_data: The failed invocation produced no samples. The corrected launch used the same frozen states, decoding settings, and seeds.

proven: Feedback conditioning did not create the predeclared behavioral basin of valid passive yields on eight fresh clean post-spawn states.
Conditioning increased sampled valid yield by only one of 64 continuations and concentrated all three conditioned yields in one state.
The conditioned teacher still produced forbidden tool actions in 61 of 64 continuations and retained the tool marker as top-1 in all eight first-decision distributions.
The current feedback-conditioned R7 self-teacher is not admitted for another natural-yield SDPO update.
not_proven: This does not reject SDPO for other feedback contracts or successful-policy sources.
This does not establish a model-capacity limit.
This does not test a teacher or representation independently demonstrated to generate valid passive yields on the same states.
conclusion.next_falsifiable_step: Keep R7 canonical and evaluate a changed source or representation of successful passive-yield policy information on these frozen states. Require the same dual behavioral and distributional admission before any new optimizer step.
